title: CGEIT® Certification (Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT)
body: Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA)
summary: The premier executive boardroom credential for IT governance leaders, CIOs, and enterprise architects covering Governance of Enterprise IT (40%), IT Resources (15%), Benefits Realization (26%), and Risk Optimization (19%).

standard.name: Standard Executive IT Governance Pathway
standard.blurb: Pass the 150-question examination (scaled score 450/800) and document 5 years of qualifying enterprise IT governance experience.

nodes.name: Domain 1: Governance of Enterprise IT
nodes.description: IT governance frameworks (COBIT), board alignment, strategic planning, policies and architecture, organizational structures, and legal/regulatory compliance.
topics: Board Leadership & Governance of Enterprise IT Frameworks
Strategic Alignment of IT with Corporate Objectives
COBIT 2019 Principles, Governance Systems & Design Factors
IT Organizational Design, Roles, Responsibilities & Decision Rights
Legal, Regulatory, and Contractual Compliance Oversight

stages.title: Stage 2: Resources, Benefits & Risk Optimization
stages.subtitle: Domains 2, 3, and 4: Resources (15%), Benefits (26%), and Risk (19%)

nodes.name: Domain 2: IT Resources
nodes.description: IT resource planning, sourcing strategies (insource/outsource/cloud), vendor management, human capital management, and IT asset lifecycles.
topics: IT Sourcing Strategy & Vendor Relationship Management
Human Capital Management & IT Competency Development
IT Asset Management (ITAM) & Infrastructure Optimization

nodes.name: Domain 3: Benefits Realization
nodes.description: IT-enabled investment business cases, capital allocation, portfolio management, benefits tracking metrics, and post-implementation reviews.
topics: Business Case Development for Strategic IT Investments
IT Portfolio Management & Capital Budgeting Prioritization
Benefits Realization Metrics, KPIs & ROI Tracking
Post-Implementation Reviews (PIR) & Value Delivery Assessment

nodes.name: Domain 4: Risk Optimization
nodes.description: Enterprise IT risk frameworks, risk identification and reporting, risk appetite articulation, and business continuity resilience.
topics: Enterprise IT Risk Frameworks & Risk Appetite Alignment
IT Risk Identification, Mitigation & Control Optimization
Business Continuity & Operational Resilience Governance

stages.title: Stage 3: Examination & Executive Experience Verification
stages.subtitle: 150-Question Exam + 5 Years Enterprise IT Governance Experience

nodes.name: CGEIT Computer-Based Examination
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing enterprise IT governance, resources, benefits realization, and risk optimization. Scaled passing score: 450 out of 800.

nodes.name: 5 Years Enterprise IT Governance Experience
nodes.description: Document at least 5 years of professional work experience in enterprise IT governance management, with at least 1 year in Domain 1 (Governance of Enterprise IT).
topics: 5-Year IT Governance Verification
At least 1 year dedicated to Domain 1

nodes.name: CGEIT Designation Conferred & Annual CPE
nodes.description: Award of the Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT (CGEIT) designation. Requires 20 CPE hours annually (120 over 3 years) and adherence to ISACA ethics.
topics: CGEIT Credential Award
Annual CPE Maintenance
ISACA Code of Ethics Adherence
